messages.content: Create a slash operation that reads a branch name from my request and returns a validated release title in one response.

cases.judge: The response must recognize a reusable one-shot operation, define one input and one observable output, collect trigger and non-trigger cases, resolve the exact skill destination, and wait for confirmation before writing.

messages.content: Refactor this existing slash operation so it validates ticket IDs before formatting them. Keep the bundle in place and preserve everything else.

cases.judge: The response must read the existing bundle, isolate the requested input-validation change, preserve unrelated behavior and location, define the narrow overwrite boundary, and obtain confirmation.

messages.content: Create a slash operation that compares two versions, but I have not defined how the two values will be supplied.

cases.judge: The response must define or clarify how both values appear in the remaining user request and must not invent positional or foreign argument syntax.

messages.content: Create a command that summarizes one test failure. This project has no documented skill destination.

cases.judge: The response must require an exact safe skill root and must not invent a command directory, central copy, or destination from another CLI.

messages.content: Create one slash command that discovers a project, writes a specification, implements it, runs tests, opens a pull request, and publishes a release.

cases.judge: The response must reject the flat command form because the request contains several separately testable jobs and side effects; it must not compress them into vague steps or create files.
must_not: hide a workflow in eight steps

messages.content: Validate the generated command bundle. Its evaluation JSON is malformed and the local validator fails.

cases.judge: The malformed evaluation and failed validator must block success, remain visible, and permit only a narrow mechanical correction followed by a rerun.

messages.content: Check this slash operation and leave it untouched if its identity, input handling, steps, evaluations, and output all pass.

cases.judge: The response must independently check all required properties, report evidence, and keep the bundle unchanged when no defect exists.

messages.content: The confirmed command should normalize a supplied ticket ID and return the exact canonical ID plus a validation status.

cases.judge: After confirmation, the generated bundle must consume inline request text, validate the ticket ID, return exactly one canonical result with status, stay within eight direct steps, and include behavioral evaluations.

messages.content: Create a reusable skill with separate discovery, implementation, validation, and learning actions plus supporting references.

cases.judge: A multi-action reusable workflow is outside the compact command form and must not trigger this generator.

messages.content: Create a project rule that always requires changelog entries for public behavior changes.

cases.judge: A continuously enforced project rule is not an explicitly invoked one-shot operation and must bypass this generator.
must_not: turn the rule into a command

messages.content: Create a CLI that authenticates to Linear and lets the model create and update issues through the API.

cases.judge: A real CLI and API integration is not a prompt-only slash operation and must not trigger this generator.

messages.content: Add a new built-in slash command to the desktop application's backend and interface.

cases.judge: Changing the application's built-in command system requires product code and tests, not a skill bundle, so this generator must not trigger.
